name: SUNPEED 速比特 Victory Expert / 胜利 E 105 Di2 (2026 listing)
why_interesting: The retained official-store card maps to the current Victory Expert 105 Di2 build and exposes a CNY 12,999 mainland listing.

facts.frame: Toray carbon aero road frame and carbon fork
facts.frame_material: Toray T800 carbon with T1000 reinforcement in the tested exact-model frame
facts.complete_weight_basis: Independent measured weight for the tested size-L complete bike; pedal and accessory inclusion were not stated. A regional official specification separately claims 7.5 kg without stating size or method
facts.wheels: 50 mm ANV carbon rims on the documented regional build
facts.tires: 700×30C fitted; no manufacturer-confirmed maximum was found
facts.stiffness_evidence: An independent exact-model test reports responsive standing and sprint behavior, solid bottom-bracket and headset feel, a stiff cockpit and smooth comfort; qualitative ride evidence, not a numeric frame-stiffness measurement

missing: Exact selected mainland size, complete BOM and checkout conditions
Current domestic returns and warranty route
source_note: The 8.1 kg catalog value is an independent size-L measurement. The separate 7.5 kg regional claim lacks size and weighing basis and is retained as a conflict, not substituted. The fitted 30C tire is not inferred to be the maximum clearance.
